subject.title: fix(cron): honor AbortSignal in waitForActiveCronTaskRuns poll

question: Should gateway restart coalescing cancel an in-progress cron-task drain, and if so which restart-lifecycle owner creates, aborts, and cleans up that signal?
rationale: The diff can only be made mechanically correct after maintainers choose whether an independently cancellable restart lifecycle exists; a timeout equal to the existing deadline does not answer that product and ownership question.

options.title: Keep deadline-only draining
options.body: Remove the optional signal and retain the bounded one-second wait unless there is a concrete lifecycle cancellation requirement.

options.title: Define restart coalescing
options.body: Specify the restart coordinator's supersession signal and lifecycle, then pass that signal through the drain wait with focused end-to-end coverage.

recommendation.title: Keep deadline-only draining
recommendation.body: Remove the optional signal and retain the bounded one-second wait unless there is a concrete lifecycle cancellation requirement.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available low-confidence routing candidate for a core gateway restart-lifecycle decision.
